known_facts_book1: Never appears in this book; she is only spoken of as a girl who came to Oz from Kansas by cyclone in the past and was sent home again by Glinda.
The Scarecrow and Tin Woodman recall past adventures with her (the Stinging Bees, the Grey Wolves, the Winged Monkeys) from before this story.
Her name is engraved among past adventurers on the Tin Woodman's silver oil-can.
Baum's Author's Note calls the real little girl who begged for the book 'a Dorothy' — not the character.

known_relations_book1.Scarecrow: Their former companion from an earlier adventure; she is gone home to Kansas and never appears here.
known_relations_book1.Nick Chopper: The Tin Woodman's former travelling companion, absent throughout this book.

known_facts_book1: Does not appear; he had already fled Oz in a balloon before this story and no one has seen him since.
Spoken of throughout as a humbug who nonetheless gave the Scarecrow his brains and the Tin Woodman his heart.
Usurped the throne of the Emerald City from King Pastoria, then stole Pastoria's infant heir Ozma and gave her to Mombi to hide, paying her with magic lessons.
Made three secret visits to Mombi, and is said (jokingly) to have come originally 'from Omaha.'
Passed the crown of the Emerald City to the Scarecrow before he left.

known_relations_book1.Mombi: Paid her with magic lessons and three secret visits to hide the transformed infant Ozma.
known_relations_book1.Scarecrow: Gave him his brains and passed him the crown before fleeing.
known_relations_book1.Pastoria: The King whose throne he usurped and whose infant daughter Ozma he hid.

known_relations_book1.Ozma: Her father; the rightful line of the Emerald City throne passes from him to Ozma.

known_facts_book1: The famous schoolmaster in whose country schoolhouse the Woggle-Bug was educated; he appears only inside the Woggle-Bug's recited history, never in the story's present.
Caught the Woggle-Bug and threw it 'highly magnified' upon a screen, allowing it to escape enlarged.

known_relations_book1.Woggle-Bug: His unnoticed pupil for years; he magnified the Woggle-Bug on a screen.

known_facts_book1: A crooked wizard living in a lonely mountain cave; never appears in person.
The maker of the Powder of Life and of Dr. Nikidik's Celebrated Wishing Pills; Mombi traded magic secrets with him for the Powder.

known_relations_book1.Mombi: Traded magical secrets to her and is the source of the Powder of Life she uses.
